name: launch_specialist
description: Launch an allowlisted Waykit specialist as a host subagent. Pass specialist id, capability class, and handover paths. For debug, pass handover_debug.md so the parent keeps the hypothesis summary, not the full log scrape. For XFN browser/load apply rows, launch agent-xfn as a separate child from agent-tdd (handover_xfn.md). When the child needs Cloudflare or PostHog MCP, pass mcpProfile and restoreProfile default — do not stack vendor MCP onto default permanently. Do not launch stack profiles. Do not split TDD gear 1 and gear 2. Stay in the parent for tiny typos.

handoverPaths.description: Handover file the parent keeps (handover_debug.md or handover_xfn.md). Not the full log scrape.

mcpProfile.description: Named MCP profile the child installs for live vendor work

restoreProfile.description: Profile to restore before returning to the parent. Required when mcpProfile is set.
